entities.name: Misak Torlakyan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Misak Torlakian was the assassin of Behbud Khan Javanshir, former Minister of Interior of Azerbaijan, in 1921. Torlakian was admitted "guilty but not responsible" due to his mental condition by a British military tribunal in October 1921.
